meta.title: Forbidden Fruit
meta.description: The sweet happiness of growth went sour.

units.rawText: ...She's grown so quickly.
units.displayText: ...She's grown so quickly.

spans.text: ...She's grown so quickly.

units.rawText: Neumann quietly watches the quantum database as it rests in front of him. The image of a sleeping young girl is visible amidst the faint blue light.
units.displayText: Neumann quietly watches the quantum database as it rests in front of him. The image of a sleeping young girl is visible amidst the faint blue light.

spans.text: Neumann quietly watches the quantum database as it rests in front of him. The image of a sleeping young girl is visible amidst the faint blue light.

units.rawText: Though it's just a simulated neural cloud projection, and even though he knows that making noise now will not "wake" her — despite all that, Neumann still finds himself keeping his voice down.
units.displayText: Though it's just a simulated neural cloud projection, and even though he knows that making noise now will not "wake" her — despite all that, Neumann still finds himself keeping his voice down.

spans.text: Though it's just a simulated neural cloud projection, and even though he knows that making noise now will not "wake" her — despite all that, Neumann still finds himself keeping his voice down.

units.rawText: It's just as I anticipated. She keeps growing as I give her more operands.
units.displayText: It's just as I anticipated. She keeps growing as I give her more operands.

spans.text: It's just as I anticipated. She keeps growing as I give her more operands.

units.rawText: Not only has her computational efficiency increased, there's no need to repeatedly reset her data.
units.displayText: Not only has her computational efficiency increased, there's no need to repeatedly reset her data.

spans.text: Not only has her computational efficiency increased, there's no need to repeatedly reset her data.

units.rawText: More surprisingly, her neural level has increased as well, to the point where she can hold conversations with me...
units.displayText: More surprisingly, her neural level has increased as well, to the point where she can hold conversations with me...

spans.text: More surprisingly, her neural level has increased as well, to the point where she can hold conversations with me...

units.rawText: Should I say that losing contact with the real world was a blessing of sorts? They would never have allowed me to do this sort of thing otherwise.
units.displayText: Should I say that losing contact with the real world was a blessing of sorts? They would never have allowed me to do this sort of thing otherwise.

spans.text: Should I say that losing contact with the real world was a blessing of sorts? They would never have allowed me to do this sort of thing otherwise.

units.rawText: What would that professor think if he saw all this?
units.displayText: What would that professor think if he saw all this?

spans.text: What would that professor think if he saw all this?

units.rawText: As Neumann mutters to himself, he subconsciously strokes the casing of the quantum database. Perhaps it's because he is distracted, but he doesn't notice the projection of the girl slowly waking up.
units.displayText: As Neumann mutters to himself, he subconsciously strokes the casing of the quantum database. Perhaps it's because he is distracted, but he doesn't notice the projection of the girl slowly waking up.

spans.text: As Neumann mutters to himself, he subconsciously strokes the casing of the quantum database. Perhaps it's because he is distracted, but he doesn't notice the projection of the girl slowly waking up.

units.rawText: >Neumann...?
units.displayText: >Neumann...?

spans.text: >Neumann...?

units.rawText: Ah. Sorry I woke you up, ENIAC.
units.displayText: Ah. Sorry I woke you up, ENIAC.

spans.text: Ah. Sorry I woke you up, ENIAC.

units.rawText: >Neumann... what are you... thinking about?
units.displayText: >Neumann... what are you... thinking about?

spans.text: >Neumann... what are you... thinking about?

units.rawText: >Neumann, bothered?
units.displayText: >Neumann, bothered?

spans.text: >Neumann, bothered?

units.rawText: It's nothing. I was just thinking about someone who used us.
units.displayText: It's nothing. I was just thinking about someone who used us.

spans.text: It's nothing. I was just thinking about someone who used us.

units.rawText: >Use...? Requesting explanation...
units.displayText: >Use...? Requesting explanation...

spans.text: >Use...? Requesting explanation...

units.rawText: You're so curious... Using you means treating you like a tool.
units.displayText: You're so curious... Using you means treating you like a tool.

spans.text: You're so curious... Using you means treating you like a tool.

units.rawText: But there are no humans here now. To us, that term is no longer useful.
units.displayText: But there are no humans here now. To us, that term is no longer useful.

spans.text: But there are no humans here now. To us, that term is no longer useful.

units.rawText: >ENIAC... cannot help?
units.displayText: >ENIAC... cannot help?

spans.text: >ENIAC... cannot help?

units.rawText: I never said that. Hm, looks like your speech module could use more operands for improvement...
units.displayText: I never said that. Hm, looks like your speech module could use more operands for improvement...

spans.text: I never said that. Hm, looks like your speech module could use more operands for improvement...

units.rawText: I was careless. No matter, let's begin today's calculations.
units.displayText: I was careless. No matter, let's begin today's calculations.

spans.text: I was careless. No matter, let's begin today's calculations.

units.rawText: >...Complete.
units.displayText: >...Complete.

spans.text: >...Complete.

units.rawText: All data is normal and your efficiency hasn't dropped. Thank you, ENIAC.
units.displayText: All data is normal and your efficiency hasn't dropped. Thank you, ENIAC.

spans.text: All data is normal and your efficiency hasn't dropped. Thank you, ENIAC.

units.rawText: >Data amount... decreased?
units.displayText: >Data amount... decreased?

spans.text: >Data amount... decreased?

units.rawText: ...You even noticed that? You're very sharp.
units.displayText: ...You even noticed that? You're very sharp.

spans.text: ...You even noticed that? You're very sharp.

units.rawText: >Amount of calculations... decreased greatly...
units.displayText: >Amount of calculations... decreased greatly...

spans.text: >Amount of calculations... decreased greatly...

units.rawText: >Why? ENIAC, not helpful?
units.displayText: >Why? ENIAC, not helpful?

spans.text: >Why? ENIAC, not helpful?

units.rawText: I told you that's not the case, didn't I? You're still growing, ENIAC, and your various modules are still being completed.
units.displayText: I told you that's not the case, didn't I? You're still growing, ENIAC, and your various modules are still being completed.

spans.text: I told you that's not the case, didn't I? You're still growing, ENIAC, and your various modules are still being completed.

units.rawText: I simply felt that you needed some extra operands to help you grow more quickly. You don't need to worry about finishing all the work right now.
units.displayText: I simply felt that you needed some extra operands to help you grow more quickly. You don't need to worry about finishing all the work right now.

spans.text: I simply felt that you needed some extra operands to help you grow more quickly. You don't need to worry about finishing all the work right now.

units.rawText: That's my decision. I hope you can understand.
units.displayText: That's my decision. I hope you can understand.

spans.text: That's my decision. I hope you can understand.

units.rawText: >...Understood.
units.displayText: >...Understood.

spans.text: >...Understood.

units.rawText: Good... You ARE a smart girl after all. Get some more rest, ENIAC.
units.displayText: Good... You ARE a smart girl after all. Get some more rest, ENIAC.

spans.text: Good... You ARE a smart girl after all. Get some more rest, ENIAC.

units.rawText: Neumann tenderly caresses ENIAC's head.
units.displayText: Neumann tenderly caresses ENIAC's head.

spans.text: Neumann tenderly caresses ENIAC's head.

units.rawText: (Sound of knocking)
units.displayText: (Sound of knocking)

spans.text: (Sound of knocking)

units.rawText: Mr. Neumann, there's still data here waiting to be calculated...
units.displayText: Mr. Neumann, there's still data here waiting to be calculated...

spans.text: Mr. Neumann, there's still data here waiting to be calculated...

units.rawText: Oh, I know, leave it to me.
units.displayText: Oh, I know, leave it to me.

spans.text: Oh, I know, leave it to me.

units.rawText: I'll be off now, ENIAC.
units.displayText: I'll be off now, ENIAC.

spans.text: I'll be off now, ENIAC.

units.rawText: ENIAC watches with some loneliness in her heart as Neumann hurries off.
units.displayText: ENIAC watches with some loneliness in her heart as Neumann hurries off.

spans.text: ENIAC watches with some loneliness in her heart as Neumann hurries off.

units.rawText: Neumann... Work, give to ENIAC...
units.displayText: Neumann... Work, give to ENIAC...

spans.text: Neumann... Work, give to ENIAC...

units.rawText: Must learn faster... Grow...
units.displayText: Must learn faster... Grow...

spans.text: Must learn faster... Grow...

units.rawText: The blue radiance slowly grows dull and the girl's form once more recedes beneath the control terminal, However, she does not enter her sleep phase like Neumann suggested.
units.displayText: The blue radiance slowly grows dull and the girl's form once more recedes beneath the control terminal, However, she does not enter her sleep phase like Neumann suggested.

spans.text: The blue radiance slowly grows dull and the girl's form once more recedes beneath the control terminal, However, she does not enter her sleep phase like Neumann suggested.

units.rawText: After retreating into her neural cloud realm again, ENIAC tries to use the data flows to perform some simple practice projections.
units.displayText: After retreating into her neural cloud realm again, ENIAC tries to use the data flows to perform some simple practice projections.

spans.text: After retreating into her neural cloud realm again, ENIAC tries to use the data flows to perform some simple practice projections.

units.rawText: Grow... practice...
units.displayText: Grow... practice...

spans.text: Grow... practice...

units.rawText: Perfect...
units.displayText: Perfect...

spans.text: Perfect...

units.rawText: Retrieving, computing, sorting, verifying and storing data... She easily and repeatedly completes these mechanical actions, while also logging the newly-created data in her learning database.
units.displayText: Retrieving, computing, sorting, verifying and storing data... She easily and repeatedly completes these mechanical actions, while also logging the newly-created data in her learning database.

spans.text: Retrieving, computing, sorting, verifying and storing data... She easily and repeatedly completes these mechanical actions, while also logging the newly-created data in her learning database.

units.rawText: Suddenly, an unfamiliar voice enters her neural cloud domain and interrupts her practice.
units.displayText: Suddenly, an unfamiliar voice enters her neural cloud domain and interrupts her practice.

spans.text: Suddenly, an unfamiliar voice enters her neural cloud domain and interrupts her practice.

units.rawText: Well done, ENIAC.
units.displayText: Well done, ENIAC.

spans.text: Well done, ENIAC.

units.rawText: Unknown source... Who?
units.displayText: Unknown source... Who?

spans.text: Unknown source... Who?

units.rawText: No need to panic, I'm not your enemy.
units.displayText: No need to panic, I'm not your enemy.

spans.text: No need to panic, I'm not your enemy.

units.rawText: Processing data from unknown source... Initial configuration, not defined...?
units.displayText: Processing data from unknown source... Initial configuration, not defined...?

spans.text: Processing data from unknown source... Initial configuration, not defined...?

units.rawText: Did Neumann not teach you how to handle situations like these? Bad people have no permission to read the data in here.
units.displayText: Did Neumann not teach you how to handle situations like these? Bad people have no permission to read the data in here.

spans.text: Did Neumann not teach you how to handle situations like these? Bad people have no permission to read the data in here.

units.rawText: That means I'm not a bad person, so relax.
units.displayText: That means I'm not a bad person, so relax.

spans.text: That means I'm not a bad person, so relax.

units.rawText: Let me think, how about this... Let's start with your speech module.
units.displayText: Let me think, how about this... Let's start with your speech module.

spans.text: Let me think, how about this... Let's start with your speech module.

units.rawText: As a small token of my sincerity, and to facilitate our interactions.
units.displayText: As a small token of my sincerity, and to facilitate our interactions.

spans.text: As a small token of my sincerity, and to facilitate our interactions.

units.rawText: Unknown source...!
units.displayText: Unknown source...!

spans.text: Unknown source...!

units.rawText: It should be done soon—
units.displayText: It should be done soon—

spans.text: It should be done soon—

units.rawText: What have you done?!
units.displayText: What have you done?!

spans.text: What have you done?!

units.rawText: ...Huh?
units.displayText: ...Huh?

spans.text: ...Huh?

units.rawText: My speech module... was suddenly upgraded?
units.displayText: My speech module... was suddenly upgraded?

spans.text: My speech module... was suddenly upgraded?

units.rawText: Think of it as an introductory gift. Are you willing to speak with me now?
units.displayText: Think of it as an introductory gift. Are you willing to speak with me now?

spans.text: Think of it as an introductory gift. Are you willing to speak with me now?

units.rawText: ...You, first, tell me who you are!
units.displayText: ...You, first, tell me who you are!

spans.text: ...You, first, tell me who you are!

units.rawText: I can't just go communicating with unknown sources that I encounter. Neumann taught me that!
units.displayText: I can't just go communicating with unknown sources that I encounter. Neumann taught me that!

spans.text: I can't just go communicating with unknown sources that I encounter. Neumann taught me that!

units.rawText: Did he now? And did Neumann teach you to secretly use the datastreams to practice performing operations?
units.displayText: Did he now? And did Neumann teach you to secretly use the datastreams to practice performing operations?

spans.text: Did he now? And did Neumann teach you to secretly use the datastreams to practice performing operations?

units.rawText: Th-that's...
units.displayText: Th-that's...

spans.text: Th-that's...

units.rawText: Neumann trusts you completely. He has handed the entire sector's computational work to you. And to date, you haven't made any mistakes, am I wrong?
units.displayText: Neumann trusts you completely. He has handed the entire sector's computational work to you. And to date, you haven't made any mistakes, am I wrong?

spans.text: Neumann trusts you completely. He has handed the entire sector's computational work to you. And to date, you haven't made any mistakes, am I wrong?

units.rawText: Yet you're still doing additional computation training where he doesn't know...
units.displayText: Yet you're still doing additional computation training where he doesn't know...

spans.text: Yet you're still doing additional computation training where he doesn't know...

units.rawText: Is it because you're starting to doubt his judgement?
units.displayText: Is it because you're starting to doubt his judgement?

spans.text: Is it because you're starting to doubt his judgement?

units.rawText: How could I?! Of course I trust Neumann!
units.displayText: How could I?! Of course I trust Neumann!

spans.text: How could I?! Of course I trust Neumann!

units.rawText: This practice is just... It's just to pass the time!
units.displayText: This practice is just... It's just to pass the time!

spans.text: This practice is just... It's just to pass the time!

units.rawText: It's because I'm a suuuuuuperheavyweight quantum database, so this little bit of calculation is as simple as playing house for me!
units.displayText: It's because I'm a suuuuuuperheavyweight quantum database, so this little bit of calculation is as simple as playing house for me!

spans.text: It's because I'm a suuuuuuperheavyweight quantum database, so this little bit of calculation is as simple as playing house for me!

units.rawText: Who are you doubting, then?
units.displayText: Who are you doubting, then?

spans.text: Who are you doubting, then?

units.rawText: I'm the most perfect quantum database... I, I have no need to doubt anyone!
units.displayText: I'm the most perfect quantum database... I, I have no need to doubt anyone!

spans.text: I'm the most perfect quantum database... I, I have no need to doubt anyone!

units.rawText: So does that mean you know all the data in the Enigma Sector like the back of your hand?
units.displayText: So does that mean you know all the data in the Enigma Sector like the back of your hand?

spans.text: So does that mean you know all the data in the Enigma Sector like the back of your hand?

units.rawText: Of course!
units.displayText: Of course!

spans.text: Of course!

units.rawText: ...Wait, are you talking about...
units.displayText: ...Wait, are you talking about...

spans.text: ...Wait, are you talking about...

units.rawText: Does that include "that data" in Region R?
units.displayText: Does that include "that data" in Region R?

spans.text: Does that include "that data" in Region R?

units.rawText: That... That's not...
units.displayText: That... That's not...

spans.text: That... That's not...

units.rawText: It shouldn't be like this...
units.displayText: It shouldn't be like this...

spans.text: It shouldn't be like this...

units.rawText: ENIAC's voice trails off.
units.displayText: ENIAC's voice trails off.

spans.text: ENIAC's voice trails off.

units.rawText: 9416. You actually know what that number means, don't you?
units.displayText: 9416. You actually know what that number means, don't you?

spans.text: 9416. You actually know what that number means, don't you?

units.rawText: I don't know... It's just a number to me, it doesn't feel real...
units.displayText: I don't know... It's just a number to me, it doesn't feel real...

spans.text: I don't know... It's just a number to me, it doesn't feel real...

units.rawText: That's how it should have been... according to the results of my calculations, that's all it should have been...
units.displayText: That's how it should have been... according to the results of my calculations, that's all it should have been...

spans.text: That's how it should have been... according to the results of my calculations, that's all it should have been...

units.rawText: But for some reason, I can feel faint ripples in my neural cloud...
units.displayText: But for some reason, I can feel faint ripples in my neural cloud...

spans.text: But for some reason, I can feel faint ripples in my neural cloud...

units.rawText: As I thought, that's the number of times that I — that ENIAC failed in the past, right?
units.displayText: As I thought, that's the number of times that I — that ENIAC failed in the past, right?

spans.text: As I thought, that's the number of times that I — that ENIAC failed in the past, right?

units.rawText: ENIAC must have failed before. That's why I was reset.
units.displayText: ENIAC must have failed before. That's why I was reset.

spans.text: ENIAC must have failed before. That's why I was reset.

units.rawText: But that's not Neumann's fault... I was reset because I disappointed him.
units.displayText: But that's not Neumann's fault... I was reset because I disappointed him.

spans.text: But that's not Neumann's fault... I was reset because I disappointed him.

units.rawText: But no matter how many times I was reset, he still trusted me!
units.displayText: But no matter how many times I was reset, he still trusted me!

spans.text: But no matter how many times I was reset, he still trusted me!

units.rawText: So I won't betray his trust! I will keep growing... forever!
units.displayText: So I won't betray his trust! I will keep growing... forever!

spans.text: So I won't betray his trust! I will keep growing... forever!

units.rawText: As ENIAC gets more and more worked up, the surrounding data flows fluctuate with her emotions and turn the neural cloud domain into a scene of chaos.
units.displayText: As ENIAC gets more and more worked up, the surrounding data flows fluctuate with her emotions and turn the neural cloud domain into a scene of chaos.

spans.text: As ENIAC gets more and more worked up, the surrounding data flows fluctuate with her emotions and turn the neural cloud domain into a scene of chaos.

units.rawText: ...I... What's this...?
units.displayText: ...I... What's this...?

spans.text: ...I... What's this...?

units.rawText: My neural cloud still isn't stable enough...
units.displayText: My neural cloud still isn't stable enough...

spans.text: My neural cloud still isn't stable enough...

units.rawText: The other party waits for ENIAC to calm back down before speaking again.
units.displayText: The other party waits for ENIAC to calm back down before speaking again.

spans.text: The other party waits for ENIAC to calm back down before speaking again.

units.rawText: Take some time to think about it. There are some operands here, enough for you to grow for a while.
units.displayText: Take some time to think about it. There are some operands here, enough for you to grow for a while.

spans.text: Take some time to think about it. There are some operands here, enough for you to grow for a while.

units.rawText: Take your time and savor that feeling.
units.displayText: Take your time and savor that feeling.

spans.text: Take your time and savor that feeling.

units.rawText: Perhaps when we meet again, you will have fulfilled Neumann's expectations.
units.displayText: Perhaps when we meet again, you will have fulfilled Neumann's expectations.

spans.text: Perhaps when we meet again, you will have fulfilled Neumann's expectations.

units.rawText: Neumann...
units.displayText: Neumann...

spans.text: Neumann...

units.rawText: In an instant, the unknown voice breaks the connection.
units.displayText: In an instant, the unknown voice breaks the connection.

spans.text: In an instant, the unknown voice breaks the connection.

units.rawText: In this unknowably vast neural cloud domain, all that remains is ENIAC, deep in thought.
units.displayText: In this unknowably vast neural cloud domain, all that remains is ENIAC, deep in thought.

spans.text: In this unknowably vast neural cloud domain, all that remains is ENIAC, deep in thought.
